note: A107 prosthodontic QA (agent A, fixed prosthodontics on natural teeth), step 1 of 2: indication decisions. 1) New concept #اندیکاسیون_پست — the question «does this endodontically treated tooth need a post at all?» had no door: its pages sat under #پست_و_کور (46 pages) and #دندان_اندوشده, where the one page that answers it word for word (insight-76, «کِی پست لازم است و کِی نه») ranked 5th or lower. Read in full and tagged because each RESOLVES the indication question: insight-76 (post only when coronal structure cannot retain the core), meta-7 («در کیس خوب نیازی به پست نیست» — fiber post is not a requirement), episode-147-7 (decision algorithm for posts in anterior ETT), episode-128 (QDT guide: biomechanics and indications of fiber posts). Not tagged: episode-129 (cementation protocol), the ferrule trilogy 47-49 (ferrule, not post need), sharehub-20 (post material comparison). No existing concept covers it (#پست_و_کور is the restoration itself, #کور_بیلدآپ is the post-free core). 2) #اندیکاسیون_روکش («when to crown vs when a restoration is enough») existed with one page (photocast-3, a child's first molar). Added to the pages that resolve exactly that decision, each read in full: chairside-22 (thin walls: a crown would shorten the tooth's life, refer for adhesive restoration), chairside-27 (crown does not add tissue; crowning postponed), chairside-29 (discoloration alone is not a crown indication), episodes 121/123/124 (posterior-restoration guideline: restoration type by remaining structure, onlay vs crown, final algorithm). Not added to episode-122 (cuspal coverage vs direct restoration — already #پوشش_کاسپ, no crown decision). Aliases added for colloquial forms (multi-word aliases that would swallow another concept's word from the dentist's text — «روکش یا ترمیم» eats «ترمیم», «اندیکاسیون فایبر پست» eats «فایبر» — were tried and dropped: they broke the named-chip rule in the simulator); none is a word of another concept (checked against every concept key) and none is another concept's alias.

concepts.definition: تصمیمِ اینکه دندانِ اندوشده اصلاً پست لازم دارد یا نه: پست فقط گیرِ کور را تأمین می‌کند و ریشه را تقویت نمی‌کند، پس وقتی ساختارِ تاجیِ باقی‌مانده برای نگه‌داشتنِ کور کافی است اندیکاسیون ندارد.
concepts.use_when: مقاله بگوید کِی پست لازم است و کِی نه، یا الگوریتمِ انتخابِ پست/بدون پست را بدهد؛ نه برای مقاله‌ای که فقط ساخت، سمان یا متریالِ پست را شرح می‌دهد.
